title: Twin Destinies
next_chapter_hook: Just as everyone believed Chen Ji was destined to die, a诡异的弧度 slowly curved at the corner of his mouth — since they would share fortune and misfortune, he would make this twin thread of destiny his strongest countermeasure against the Demonic Path.

text.content: Night wind cut like a blade, slicing through the valley's silence. Chen Ji stood at the cliff's edge, the jade slip in his hand still warm. Three urgent messages burned into his palm like brands: 'Demonic Path Commander's identity in doubt' 'The mastermind behind the marriage humiliation' 'Likely this very person.' Each word weighed tons, causing the spiritual energy around him to tremble.

dialogue.content: 'You finally found your way here.' Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul drifted from the first page of the Tianji Record, his illusory form flickering uncertainly under the moonlight. 'This old man has waited far too long for this day.'

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze turned icy cold: 'Mo Xiansheng, have you been watching the show from the beginning?' His voice was calm, yet the air pressure around him was terrifyingly low. Three years of planning, countless life-or-death gambles — and now he learned it was merely a single move on someone else's chessboard.

dialogue.content: 'Not watching a show, but waiting for the right moment.' Mo Xiansheng smiled bitterly as his phantom slowly unfurled a yellowed scroll of destiny. 'Do you know that you and the Demonic Path Commander — were originally one body with two souls?'

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. One body with two souls? These four words froze like ten thousand years of ice, instantly chilling every meridian in his body. He stared intently at the scroll of destiny, where two intertwined beams of light spiraled like yin and yang fish — one warm as spring sunshine, the other biting cold as an abyss.

dialogue.content: 'The Heavenly Will split the Heavenly Fate a hundred years ago, half granted to a Tianqing Sect abandoned infant, half cast into the Demonic Path abyss.' Mo Xiansheng's voice was low and grave. 'You are twin children of destiny — sharing fortune and misfortune.' He paused, his gaze complex: 'In other words, if you die, he lives; if you live, he... cannot survive alone.'

text.content: Chen Ji clenched his fists abruptly, his knuckles white. He remembered the strange warning from the system when he awakened the Tianji Record in the ruins: 'Heavenly Fate value insufficient, prediction results contain fatal blind spots.' He had thought it was a cultivation limitation, but now he realized — that blind spot was clearly his twin brother's fate interfering with Heavenly Secrets!

'So for these three years...' Chen Ji's voice was hoarse, 'every time I foresaw the future, I was actually gambling with his fate?' Mo Xiansheng nodded: 'The Tianji Record can only predict chess games you both participate in. Individual victories or defeats, life or death — it cannot see.'

Moonlight poured down, illuminating half of Chen Ji's face, pale as paper. He suddenly threw his head back and laughed wildly, the sorrowful sound echoing through the valley: 'What a Heavenly Will! What twin destines! No wonder the Tianqing Sect discarded me like refuse back then, no wonder the Demonic Path Saintess said there was a familiar aura about me — turns out we are two flowers blooming from the same seed!'

choice.prompt: The double-edged sword of destiny hangs at his throat — Chen Ji must make a choice —

choices.text: Defy Heaven and Change Fate, Break the Binding
choices.description: Search for rule loopholes left by the Heavenly Will, use the Tianji Record Fragment's integrity to exchange for the possibility of severing the twin bond. High risk, high reward.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain a fate independent of the Demonic Path Commander
choices.risk_hint: May trigger direct intervention from the Heavenly Will

text.content: Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a moment, his phantom trembling violently: 'You wish to take the most difficult path?' A hint of respect even entered his voice: 'The Tianji Record's integrity concerns both our existences. Are you truly willing to gamble?'

choices.text: Use Poison to Counter Poison, Turn the Tables
choices.description: Since you share fortune and misfortune, then operate in reverse — when he is weak you are strong, when he breaks through you can borrow momentum. The true game has just begun.
choices.visible_reward: Unlock the 'Destiny Resonance' skill, can sense the Demonic Path Commander's state and borrow his momentum
choices.risk_hint: The Demonic Path Commander may inversely exploit this binding

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's eyes flashed brilliantly, applauding with laughter: 'Wonderful! Borrow the momentum of fate to perform deeds against fate — this is the spirit the one I chose should possess!' The remnant soul was so agitated it nearly materialized: 'This old man shall now teach you the method of 'Destiny Resonance'!'

Chen Ji stood with hands behind his back, cold light in his eyes like a prairie fire spreading. He suddenly recalled Su Qingyao's icy gaze on the day their marriage was annulled; remembered the faint blood pulse resonance when the Tianji Record awakened. So everything had been foreshadowed, and he — was merely a自以为是的棋子 on destiny's chessboard.

dialogue.content: At this moment, an无形威压 descended from the void. It was a presence beyond all mortal comprehension — as if countless eyes from beyond the nine heavens gazed down, coldly examining those who dared peer into Heavenly Fate. An ancient and majestic voice echoed from the heavens: 'Mortal, you covet Heavenly Secrets?'

text.content: Chen Ji's hair stood on end. This was the Heavenly Will — that terrifying existence that had scattered the Tianji Record across the mortal world and treated generations of prophets as chess pieces! Had he been noticed so early? Or had he been under its watchful gaze from the moment the Tianji Record awakened?

choice.prompt: Heavenly Eye descends with pressure, Chen Ji faces a life-or-death choice —

choices.description: Immediately question the Heavenly Will why it bound him with the Demonic Path Commander, forcing the other party to reveal more flaws. Extremely high risk, but may obtain crucial information.
choices.visible_reward: May trigger revelation of the Heavenly Will's rules
choices.risk_hint: May be instantly erased or receive a Heavenly Curse

text.content: Chen Ji abruptly lifted his head, his eyes blazing with fierce light: 'This junior does not dare covet Heavenly Secrets, but wishes to ask — why did Heaven arrange such a scheme?' The pressure suddenly faltered, as if even the Heavenly Will hadn't expected a mortal to dare counter-question.

choices.text: Pretend Foolishness, Temporarily Avoid the Edge
choices.description: Immediately收敛气息, pretend complete ignorance of the fate binding, plan again after the Heavenly Will departs. Preserve hidden cards.
choices.visible_cost: Miss the opportunity to learn Heavenly truths
choices.visible_reward: The Heavenly Will temporarily loses interest in you
choices.risk_hint: May be seen through by the Heavenly Will at a critical moment

text.content: Chen Ji instantly收敛 all his edge, bowing respectfully: 'This junior was merely comprehending the Tianji Record Fragment, not knowing which senior's dharma presence I disturbed, I beg forgiveness.' The pressure examined him briefly, then suddenly receded. Mo Xiansheng secretly relaxed, giving him an approving look.

The pressure receded like an ebbing tide, the valley returned to dead silence. Chen Ji's back was soaked with cold sweat, his fingertips trembling slightly. The stakes of this round were too high — so high he could almost feel death's cold presence circling his neck.

But a cold smile slowly curved at the corner of his mouth. 'Mo Xiansheng, I remember this.' His voice was terrifyingly calm. 'When the time is right, I shall let that so-called Heavenly Eye know — what it feels like when a chess piece turns the tables.' Mo Xiansheng was silent for a long while, sighing: 'I am glad you possess such ambition. But before that, you must first survive the Demonic Path Commander.'

Chen Ji suddenly closed his eyes, his consciousness sinking deep into the Mental Sea. The Tianji Record Fragment slowly unfurled within his divine soul, and on the yellowed pages, an ancient seal-script text glowed faintly: 'Twin Destinies, breaths intertwined. When they are strong, I am weak; when they are weak, I am strong.' His eyes snapped open, pupils reflecting an explosive light of brilliant calculation.

choice.prompt: A crazy idea took shape in Chen Ji's mind —

choices.text: Deliberately Show Weakness, Fatten the Demonic Path Commander
choices.description: Since when they are strong I am weak, then let the Demonic Path Commander grow ever stronger — until he becomes so powerful that Heaven notices, that Heavenly Tribulation arrives! Use Heavenly Tribulation's hand to slay the twin destine, while hiding behind the scenes oneself.
choices.visible_cost: Requires long-term endurance, may be misunderstood by allies
choices.visible_reward: Unlock the 'Borrow Momentum' skill: can borrow partial fortune during others' life-and-death breakthroughs
choices.risk_hint: The Demonic Path Commander may discover the truth first

text.content: Chen Ji laughed coldly: 'What a beautiful sharing of fortune! Then I'll let him reach the pinnacle of prosperity — to the extreme where even Heaven cannot tolerate him!' Mo Xiansheng drew a sharp breath: 'You wish to use Heavenly Tribulation to sever destiny? Do you know the price...' 'Price?' Chen Ji interrupted him, 'Compared to being bound by fate, I'd rather gamble against Heaven!'

choices.text: Proactively Activate Destiny Resonance, Sense Enemy Location
choices.description: Utilize the twin's special connection, proactively sense the Demonic Path Commander's position and state, create information asymmetry at critical moments. Steady approach but may be inversely tracked.
choices.visible_cost: Each use consumes a small amount of Heavenly Fate
choices.visible_reward: Obtain real-time position and state sensing of the Demonic Path Commander
choices.risk_hint: Activation may be sensed by the other party

text.content: Chen Ji formed seals with both hands, the Tianji Record Fragment roaring within his Mental Sea. A faint connection suddenly established — he 'saw' the Demonic Path Commander thousands of miles away, sitting alone on a blood-red throne, countless demonic cultivators kneeling before him. It was a man with features similar to his own yet a diametrically opposite temperament. 'Found you.' Chen Ji's gaze burned like torches. 'So you've been here all along.'

Night wind blew past again, carrying faint sounds of battle cries from distant battlefields. Chen Ji stood at the cliff's edge with hands behind his back, his robes fluttering in the wind. His eyes no longer held the shock and fury from before, but a kind of madness-tinged tranquility. The Heavenly Will wished to trap him with twin destines? Fine. Then he would refine this prison into the sharpest blade in heaven and earth! 'Demon Path Commander...' he murmured softly, the curve of his lips sinister. 'My good brother, the game between us has just begun.' In the distance, thunder seemed to rumble隐隐, as if Heaven itself was responding to this audacious declaration.
